messages:
elaine: Morning — I pushed a PRD draft for the 'Adaptive routing + batching' launch, focused on customer-driven latency/cost wins. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/prd/adaptive-routing-v1 Please skim; we need cross-team decisions by Friday EOD.

samir: skimming now. quick q: is this the thing that dynamically reroutes to quantized replicas?

elaine: yes — primary idea: route by latency target + cost budget. fallback to quantized/cheaper model if SLOs would be missed.

mira: added some edge-case notes in the doc about partial responses when fallback triggers mid-stream.

elaine: good call. we should define expected user-visible behavior. I added an acceptance criteria section but want ops/infra + runtime to confirm feasibility.

archi-bot: new PRD version uploaded by elaine at 2026-02-12T09:12Z — change: added rollout plan and canary steps.

devon: quick thought from infra: autoscale + routing interplay could thrash if we don't stabilize the metric we route on. recommend a 30s smoothing window.

samir: noted. runtime team: can you support a smoothing window and a hard limit on route changes/sec?

mira: runtime can do rate-limit on route changes. smoothing window is fine. we need to decide on the default in config though.

elaine: proposal in doc (please react): default smoothing 30s, route-change cap 2/sec per model pool.

samir: :thumbsup: from me.

devon: :+1: also we should have a kill-switch toggle at infra edge to force single-model routing if necessary.

elaine: added kill-switch requirement to rollout plan.

mira: I added acceptance criteria snippet — putting it here so it's clear in thread:```Acceptance criteria:
- End-to-end p95 latency <= 250ms on benchmark agent for 10k daily active users workload
- Fallback correctness: when primary model exceeds CPU threshold, requests route to fallback with no more than 1% token-drop errors
- Canary: 5% traffic for 48h with automated rollback on error rate > 0.5%
- Observability: traces show route decision and downstream model id for every request
- Feature flag: adaptive_routing_v1 with rollout config per-customer
```

samir: couple of edge cases I added: 1) cold KV cache on fallback causes latency spike — mitigation: warm caches on canary nodes; 2) partial tokens when switching mid-stream — mitigation: prefer routing decision at request start.

elaine: captured. please confirm warm-cache steps in rollout checklist.

devon: ops will pre-warm caches during canary using traffic mirroring. adding to checklist.

mira: another acceptance detail: define what counts as "token-drop errors" — suggest: any response that ends with an incomplete final token or known truncation marker.

samir: agree. add automated evals comparing before/after samples.

elaine: updated doc rules: token-drop errors = model truncations detected by post-processor + user-reported truncations > heuristic.

archi-bot: decision recorded: ROUTING_METRIC = latency_headroom_pct ; smooth_window = 30s ; route_changes_cap = 2/sec ; canary_pct = 5% ; canary_duration = 48h. by elaine, devon, mira.

devon: ops note: need runbook step -> if canary error spikes, flip kill-switch, then rollback model variant. added to runbook.

samir: security ask: confirm no PII routing changes outside region. adaptive routing must preserve region pinning.

mira: yes — routing policy respects `region_required` flag. fallback only to replicas in same region or private pool. adding to PRD.

elaine: ok — almost there. can each team post a one-line signoff here if they accept the PRD as-is for launch planning?

samir: runtime signoff — supporting smoothing, cap, canary logic.

mira: product infra signoff — checklist items added, will coordinate canary ops.

devon: ops signoff — kill-switch + pre-warm cache + monitoring are in our plan.

elaine: thanks all. decision log appended in doc. I'll schedule the stakeholder sync for Thursday to confirm timelines and carve out dev windows.

samir: tiny follow-up: add an explicit rollback SLA (who acts within how long). suggested: 30min response target during canary.

elaine: added rollback SLA: on-call response + initial mitigation within 30m.

archi-bot: PRD status: signoffs=3/3, pending stakeholder sync.
